reviews.text: I’ve been using this for 3 years and love it so much. No fragrance and super gentle on my sensitive skin. No stinging. Yes it leaves quite a white cast but I have light skin so it’s like a tone up cream on me.
reviews.zh: 我用咗三年，非常鍾意。冇香味，對我嘅敏感肌超溫和，冇刺痛感。雖然會有少少泛白感，但我皮膚較白，所以用喺我身上就好似提亮霜咁。

reviews.text:
I live in the country where the summer season is eight months long and nourishing sunblock is a must. 
This product is a wonderful combination of daily moisturiser and the sunblock that leaves the skin moist but not oily for long hours. 
I’m very happy and satisfied from this product.
reviews.zh:
我住喺一個夏天長達八個月嘅國家，所以滋養型防曬係必需品。
呢款產品係日常保濕霜同防曬嘅絕佳結合，令皮膚長時間都保持滋潤，但唔會油。
我對呢款產品好滿意。

reviews.text: This is my favorite mineral sunscreen. Yes it can be quite brightening (white cast) but it doesn’t irritate my skin, and has such a nice glow. I will forever repurchase!
reviews.zh: 呢款係我最鍾意嘅礦物防曬。佢確實會令膚色比較提亮（有泛白感），但唔會刺激我嘅皮膚，而且有好靚嘅光澤感。我會一直回購！

reviews.text:
i believe that korean sunscreen always has good quality!! same as this one!
and make your skin tone brighter(not the fake white) , it's let yourself looks nature good!
reviews.zh:
我相信韓國防曬嘅質素一定好！呢款都係一樣好！
而且可以令膚色提亮（唔係假白），令你睇落自然又好看。

reviews.text: My skin gets red and irritated and also becomes bumpy and my skin gets oily but the oiliness kinda vanishes also as physical sunscreen it is good, at first it has a white cast but after minutes the skin will absorb it.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚會發紅、刺激，亦會起粒，同埋會出油，但係油脂感好似會消失咗。作為物理防曬嚟講，佢幾好，一開始會有泛白感，但幾分鐘之後皮膚就會吸收。

reviews.text: This is a really nice sunscreen that works well under makeup. It doesn't irritate my skin or break me out. This does have a little bit of fragrance but it's not that strong. Highly recommend.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬真係好好，用喺底妝下面都好好。唔會刺激我嘅皮膚，亦唔會令我長痘。佢有少少香味，但唔算太濃。非常推薦。

reviews.text: i do like this suns cream alot , it hasnt broken me out but it does leave a white cast which im not as bothered with if i wait a while for it to disapear but no problems with makeup!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款防曬霜，冇令我長痘，但確實會有泛白感。不過如果等一陣子讓佢消失，我就唔太介意。化妝亦冇問題！

reviews.text: Not too thick/suffocating but still feels moisturizing, and doesn’t disturb makeup. It looks like it has a tone up effect when I use it which I don’t mind. But if you’re darker than #23 it might look like a white cast. Like the other d’Alba sun creams it’s very glowy, so oily ppl beware. But if you have combo skin that’s dry on the inside and oily on the outside this will be nice for winter! Also a nice citrus smell~!
reviews.zh: 唔會太厚、唔會悶，但仍然有保濕感，亦唔會影響化妝。用嘅時候睇落好似有提亮效果，我唔介意。但如果你膚色比 #23 深，可能會有泛白感。好似其他 d'Alba 防曬霜一樣，光澤感好強，所以油性皮膚要留意。不過，如果你係內乾外油嘅混合皮膚，冬天用呢款會好好。仲有一股好聞嘅柑橘香味～！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
